questions.question: What is React?
options: A JavaScript library for building user interfaces
A server-side programming language
A database management system
A CSS framework
questions.correctAnswer: A JavaScript library for building user interfaces

questions.question: What is useState hook used for?
options: To make HTTP requests
To add local state to a functional component
To route between pages
To write CSS styles inside JavaScript
questions.correctAnswer: To add local state to a functional component

questions.question: Explain Event Loop in JavaScript
options: A loop that iterates over array elements synchronously
A component that renders UI elements recursively
A mechanism that handles asynchronous callbacks and single-threaded execution
A built-in method for sorting object keys
questions.correctAnswer: A mechanism that handles asynchronous callbacks and single-threaded execution

questions.question: What is the this keyword?
options: A variable used to store global application state
Refers to the object that is executing the current function
A function used to import external modules
A reserved word used strictly for loops
questions.correctAnswer: Refers to the object that is executing the current function

questions.question: Which method is used to merge arrays?
options: concat()
push()
join()
slice()

questions.question: What is closure in JavaScript?
options: A function combined with references to its surrounding state (lexical environment)
A method to close a browser tab programmatically
A way to terminate a running switch statement
A feature to clear local storage automatically
questions.correctAnswer: A function combined with references to its surrounding state (lexical environment)
